newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Hand grenade explodes in Slovenia's second city.
newsitem.headline: Hand grenade explodes in Slovenia's second city.

text.p: A hand grenade exploded in central Maribor in Slovenia on Wednesday night, the eighth blast in the northeastern city this year, police said on Friday.
The grenade detonated on a pavement, nine metres (yards) from the nearest building, but caused little damage and no injuries, Maribor police spokesman Vlado Maksimovic said.
"We suspect some individuals but we do not yet know the motive behind this," he said.
He said he did not believe the explosion was connected to other blasts in Maribor, 135 km (80 miles) east of Ljubljana.
Maksimovic said the large number of explosions in the area could be attributed to the proximity of Austrian and Croatian borders, which may have led to an influx of illegal weapons.
The other explosions, some wrecking town centre bars, have not caused serious injury.
